mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value weights on future cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 90,000 jobs signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer and business confidence and compressing earnings expectations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates softening aggregate demand, which compresses corporate earnings expectations and reduces growth in equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 indicates strengthening aggregate supply capacity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 500 indicates cooling housing demand, which compresses corporate earnings expectations and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in cooling periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a stronger labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
